subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the existing pi-tui behavior only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported user-configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but a configurable preference would add public config or CLI surface under a repo policy that sets a high bar for new options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Add docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow config or CLI surface for send/newline keybindings with default and customized behavior tests.

options.title: Narrow To Related Trackers
options.body: Keep this issue docs/help-only and route broader composer preferences to the separate WebChat shortcut and external-editor issues.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Add docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact issue and have the strongest current TUI docs/editor history signal.
